en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate wooden kiosk inside a large building, likely a railway station or similar transport hub. The kiosk has decorative panels, glass windows with small panes, and posters on the side. Inside stands a woman behind a counter, surrounded by neatly displayed books, newspapers, and many picture postcards hanging and standing in racks.
